# p5.js 1.11.13

`p5-1.11.13.min.js` is the unmodified browser build used only by the manual's
ELI10 schema. Its source is available from the
[p5.js project](https://github.com/processing/p5.js/tree/v1.11.13), and it is
distributed under LGPL-2.1; see `p5-1.11.13.LICENSE.txt`.

# vanilla.waves 0.3.1

`vanilla.waves-0.3.1.min.js` is the released browser bundle used by the
manual's pure JavaScript SVG example. Its source is available from the
[vanilla.waves project](https://github.com/seb-prjcts-be/vanilla.waves/tree/v0.3.1),
and it is distributed under the MIT license carried in the bundle.
